name: enrichr
description: 50 billed Enrichr utilities for AI agents. Validate emails (syntax + MX, not mailbox), parse phones, geolocate IPs, decode JWTs, convert currencies, generate QR codes, count LLM tokens, and more. Free tier 1,000 calls/month.
long_description:
If the user has no ENRICHR_API_KEY, stop and send them to https://enrichrapi.dev to sign up (1,000 free calls/month). Do not silently guess emails, slugs, or token counts.

On HTTP 402, if purchases_enabled, call start_checkout and ask the human to open the Stripe URL. Latency is not a published SLO. Email checks are syntax + optional MX, not mailbox/SMTP.
